title: Aspects of Nature-Based Recreation Activities
descriptions: The dataset represents 200 reviews of ten land and water-based recreation activities (20 reviews per activity) annotated as part of the study reported in Egorova, E. (2021) Using Textual Volunteered Geographic Information to Model Nature-Based Activities: A Case Study from Aotearoa New Zealand. The ten activities include: caving, biking, horse trekking, walking/trekking, diving, kayaking/canoeing, fishing, swimming with mammals, rafting, and sailing.
